thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT OPENED — Elevated 5xx and latency from us-east-1 impacting Hosted API endpoints and several Dedicated pools. Monitoring alerts fired at 06:00 UTC. Please ACK if on-call.

emily: ACK — oncall here. Seeing alerts and increased 5xx rates from gw-prod-us-east-1 and dlr-hosted.

sam: Looking. CloudWatch shows 5xx spike starting ~05:55 UTC across multiple ELBs in us-east-1. Latency p50→p95 increased from 80ms→600ms.

maria: Support reports two enterprise customers opened tickets about timeouts and 502s on generation calls. They're asking for ETA.

emily: Quick triage: 1) confirm AWS regional outage? 2) check internal routing/fallbacks for Hosted API and Dedicated pools.

charlie: AWS Health Dashboard (https://status.aws.amazon.com) shows degraded networking in us-east-1 affecting EC2 and ELB. There are ongoing reports for increased latencies.

sam: Correlating: errors are primarily upstream 502/504s from model-workers hitting unavailable S3/gateway endpoints; ELB logs show 502 from target. Also seeing connection resets between inference nodes and model-store in the region.

emily: Immediate mitigations we can run now: 1) fail traffic for Hosted API routes away from us-east-1 to us-west-2/eu-west-1 via smart-routing. 2) move Dedicated pool standby capacity in other regions (if configured). 3) set customer rate-limits to fail-fast for affected tenants to reduce load. Which is fastest?

oliver: Two notes: - Hosted API uses per-route routing policy; we can toggle region preference to prefer us-west-2 in ~2-3min. - Some Dedicated pools are pinned to us-east-1 and cannot be moved without customer sign-off; we have to rely on fallback pools if available.

sam: I'll start routing override now. Command: 
```
# promote us-west-2 as preferred for routing policy 'hosted-default'
redwoodctl routing set-preference hosted-default --preferred-region us-west-2 --force
```
Expect propagation <5m.

emily: Done, triggered reroute. Watching logs for reduction.

maria: Notifying affected customers with incident status. Draft status note: "We're seeing elevated 5xx and latency in us-east-1 due to AWS regional issues. We're routing traffic to other regions and will provide updates." Approve? :thinking:

emily: Approve, send now and mark impacted tiers.

pd-bot: PagerDuty: Emily acknowledged the incident (INC-4521) and assigned to SRE.

charlie: Observation: After routing change, partial drop in errors for Hosted API within ~6 minutes, but a subset of Dedicated pools still report high 502s — likely because their workers are still pinned or warmers are failing.

sam: For Dedicated pools stuck in us-east-1, we can: 1) attempt soft-restart of pool agents to re-register to fallback control plane 2) if possible, enable degraded-mode that drops large-batch streaming to reduce backend stress. Which pool IDs are impacted?

emily: Affected pools: dp-023, dp-117, dp-198. dp-023 has multi-az fallback off. Customer contact for dp-117 has been notified.

oliver: I'll try soft-restart on dp-023 agent set A (targets: infra1..3). Command: 
```
infractl pool restart --pool dp-023 --agents infra1,infra2 --graceful
```
Doing now.

sam: Also seeing increased error traces in observability ingestion — Datadog ingest is delayed for traces from us-east-1 which is making debugging slower. Might be downstream vendor slowness too.

emily: Noting: this is multi-dep failure: AWS regional network + observability ingestion delays. Keep incident severity P1 given customer impact.

maria: Support update sent to customers at 06:15 UTC with routing workaround and estimated next update in 30m.

charlie: infractl restart returned success but agents are failing health checks when trying to contact S3 endpoints for model cache. Probably affected by the same AWS networking.

sam: Mitigation: enable partial caching bypass to fetch from remote aggregates in other regions — risky but could reduce hot-model 502s. Command: 
```
redwoodctl config set --scope pool:dp-023 model_cache.bypass=true
```
I'll coordinate rollback if issues.

emily: Proceed with bypass on dp-023 only. Monitor closely.

(10 minutes later)

sam: Bypass applied for dp-023. Error rate dropped ~40% for that pool, but p95 latency still elevated.

oliver: For customers pinned to Dedicated in us-east-1 without fallback, ops recommends contacting them for migration plans; meanwhile we can provision emergency spare capacity in us-west-2 for critical customers. That will take ~20-30m to warm.

emily: Start provisioning spares for dp-117 and dp-198 in us-west-2. Use reserved instance pools if possible.

charlie: I'm preparing a consolidated incident summary for execs and postmortem skeleton. Key points: AWS us-east-1 networking issue causing ELB/EC2 instability -> increased 502/504 -> Hosted traffic rerouted successfully -> Dedicated pools partially mitigated by cache bypass + agent restarts -> ongoing latency for some pinned Dedicated customers.

maria: Support updated customers at 06:45 UTC: we're routing Hosted API traffic away and working on Dedicated migrations; we don't have an ETA for full restoration.

pd-bot: PagerDuty: escalation triggered to Engineering Lead (Sam) at 06:50 UTC.

emily: Handoff checklist for next on-call (night): 1) incident link: INC-4521, current mitigations performed and commands executed (routing override, cache bypass, pool restarts), 2) pools still impacted: dp-117, dp-198, 3) customer list + support contacts in #support-incidents, 4) next steps: warm spares in us-west-2, continue monitoring ELB/CloudWatch and Datadog traces, update status page.

sam: Adding runbook links: https://infra.redwood/devices/runbooks/aws-regional-outage and hosted-routing runbook.

emily: Tagging Charlie for postmortem lead. Charlie — please take PM for postmortem and timeline.

charlie: Will do. I'll capture timelines and config diffs. Tentative postmortem template will include: timeline, root cause hypotheses (AWS regional network flap + vendor ingestion latency), mitigation chronology, customer impact summary, and actions (improve multi-region fallback for Dedicated, add warm spares, add automatic degraded-mode toggle).

(handoff)

emily: Handoff complete at 07:00 UTC. Assigning to night oncall. I am stepping out, will be on call if needed. :white_check_mark:
